test_title: PYST 44: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word to fill in the blank in the sentence.**

**Daunt**

My coach said, "Failures didn't ______ the hero."
solution: The correct answer is **"discourage."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Daunt"** means to discourage or intimidate someone. (डराना या निरुत्‍साहित करना) • **Example**: *Don't be **daunted**__ by all the controls.* • The synonym of **"Daunt"** is **"discourage."** • **"Discourage"** means to stop somebody doing something, especially by making him/her realize that it would not be successful or a good idea. ((किसी व्‍यक्ति को) निरुत्‍साहित करना (यह समझाते हुए कि सफलता नहीं मिलेगी)) __ • **Example**: *I did not want to **discourage**__ you.* • The sentence is saying that failures did not discourage the hero. • The correct answer is Option 3. **Correct sentence**: *My coach said, "Failures didn't __**discourage**__ the hero."* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: Brave** means courageous or fearless. (बहादुर, साहसी, वीर) • **Option 2: Moralize** means to teach or preach moral lessons. (दूसरों को नैतिकता का उपदेश देना) • **Option 4: Hopeless **means giving no hope that something/somebody will be successful or get better. (निराशापूर्ण काम में सफलता या बेहतरी की आशा से रहित) 3b:T53e, The correct answer is **"Having to start all over again."**
